selection: first 8 base ids, frozen before CountGD and MolmoPoint scores
window_opening: no such class in this dataset; do not map window onto opening
box_format: two x and two y, normalized 0-1, axis-aligned; stored as xyxy_norm
point_match: a point hits a box only if it lies inside that one box; a point in several boxes is ambiguous and is not a true positive; bbox AP is not computed from points
